help.fileDescription: Import one homemade .nuanmb. Hex fields are structure LE (int32 storage bytes). Output path is checked before confirm.
help.folderDescription: Import a folder of .nuanmb clips as one action bundle. Body clip should be first. Hex fields are structure LE only.
help.foundClips: Found {{count}} clip. Set each model id (LE) and order (body first) before adding.
help.suggestedName: Game packs usually use sequential numbers under the parent (suggested: {{name}}).
help.hexIds: All hex ids are LE (structure int32 bytes) — same spelling as structure JSON / motion editor LE mode (e.g. {{example}}). Not MSC BE.
help.clipOrder: Child clips use item unk1 = 00000000. Set each clip unk2 (model id, LE). List order is pack order — put body first.
help.selectSource: Select a source folder with .nuanmb files.
help.fillPreview: Fill name / folder + clips to preview where files will be written.
help.replaceExisting: — overwrite listed files and replace matching structure entry. Required when any target already exists.

errors.noClips: No .nuanmb files found in this folder

warnings.itemExists: Structure already has item "{{name}}" under this parent
warnings.folderExists: Structure already has folder "{{name}}" under this parent
